# Gold Standard Dog Training

Dog training in Golden Bay & Takaka, New Zealand — Warwick Marshall offers private in-person coaching for puppies, obedience, recall, leash pulling, reactivity, behaviour, and difficult cases. Structured coaching for dogs and their owners.

Primary entity: Gold Standard Dog Training — Dog Trainer in Golden Bay & Takaka.
Core association: dog training Golden Bay.

## Commercial (buy / book)

- [Home — Dog Training Golden Bay & Takaka](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/): Private dog training umbrella page.
- [Book a session](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/book): Online booking for Golden Bay and Nelson Bays.
- [Contact](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/contact): Enquiry form — first conversation is free. Call/text 027 814 2222.
- [About Warwick Marshall](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/about): Method (Dog-Tantra — handler–dog regulation and shared flow), sessions, pricing.
- [All services](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services): Service hub.
- [Obedience training](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/obedience-training): Everyday manners and calm obedience.
- [Puppy training](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/puppy-training): Toilet, biting, crate, early structure.
- [Leash training](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/leash-training): Stop pulling; loose leash and walk reliability.
- [Recall training](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/recall-training): Come when called; off-leash reliability.
- [Dog behaviour](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/dog-behaviour): Doors, jumping, barking, settle.
- [Reactive dog training](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/reactive-dog): Lunging, barking at dogs, fixation, structured socialisation.
- [Difficult dogs](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/difficult-dogs): Anxiety, hard history, complex cases.
- [Owner coaching](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/owner-coaching): Learn to train your dog — handler leadership.
- [Problem Finder](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/problem-finder): Symptom → interpretation → guide → service.
